question: Does a strictly leak-free masked structural pretraining of only half_encoder / side / compose (the modules that produce BOSI-B's partner content, which was shown to be load-bearing) improve held-out raw-y MAE without new labels, new molecules or any architecture change?

model.architecture: frozen BOSI v0/B, arm B, 473,889 parameters, six modules
model.reader: not used by the pretext path; keeps the historical per-seed initial state in the supervised run

mask.selection: max(1, round(ratio * n)) per molecule, without replacement
mask.visit_index: pretraining epoch counter, 1..120; probe batches use 1000000
mask.topology: types only: bond_index / edges are never deleted, so the T/Q/R/N relation cache, the biconnected blocks and the closure counts are exactly the frozen v0 objects
mask.rebuild: every type-dependent feature cell is recomputed from the masked raw graph: atom_feat 0:28, 42:46, 46:74, 74:102; bond_feat 0:4; global 19:23, 31, 32
mask.rebuild_equivalence: verified bit-identical to structural_relation_objects_v1.build_mol_objects on the masked raw graph

heads.H_atom: input = sum of c[e] over the physical bonds incident to the masked atom v; 96 -> 160 -> 28; target = v's raw atom type
heads.H_bond: input = c[e] of the masked physical bond e; 96 -> 160 -> 4; target = e's raw bond type

forbidden: predicting an arbitrary unlocalised partner identity from the aggregated partner moments
global33 or any graph-level reader as a pretext head input
any head input other than the frozen BOSI bond state c[e]
pretext.checkpoint_rule: last-step state only; reconstruction accuracy never selects a checkpoint
pretext.pretraining_data_boundary: Fit8k raw structures only; no labels, no Monitor/Locked/official rows

pilot_gate.probe: fixed 1,024 Fit8k rows, mask visit_index 1000000, both heads
conditions_all_required: atom probe CE <= marginal atom CE - 0.10 nats
bond probe CE <= marginal bond CE - 0.02 nats
pilot_gate.if_not_all: PRETEXT_NO_GO: stop, no supervised run, no further pretraining

S_s1.condition: purchased only if the seed-0 Monitor gate fires

C_s0.init: historical BOSI-B seed 0 best_monitor (hash-verified), no SSL
C_s0.updates: N_0 extra updates after the frozen 47,400-step schedule
C_s0.condition: purchased only if both SSL seeds show a Monitor gain

C_s1.init: historical BOSI-B seed 1 best_monitor (hash-verified), no SSL
C_s1.updates: N_1 extra updates after the frozen 47,400-step schedule

supervised.recipe: the frozen BOSI v0 / partner-content recipe, unchanged: Fit8k, batch 128, AdamW 1e-3 -> 1e-5 per-step cosine, warm-up 500, wd 1e-5, clip 5, raw-y L1, batch order Generator(seed+101), strict-minimum Monitor checkpoint
supervised.c_extra_updates_rule: N_s = round(pretrain wall seconds of seed s / measured supervised seconds per update of the BOSI-SSL run of seed s), frozen in analysis/control_budget.json before C is trained. C continues the frozen batch-order stream after the epoch of B's best_monitor checkpoint at the terminal learning rate 1e-5; checkpoint selection stays strict-minimum Monitor over {loaded historical state} U {epoch ends}.
supervised.inference_identity: the exported model is bit-identical in structure and parameter set to historical BOSI-B (473,889 parameters, six modules, no pretext head)
supervised.candidate_rule_c: the loaded historical checkpoint is a candidate under the same strict-minimum Monitor rule, so the control is conservative: extra compute can never be charged against it

purchase_gates.compute_control: both seeds have Monitor(SSL_s) < Monitor(B_s) and seed-mean Monitor(SSL) <= seed-mean Monitor(B) - 0.004

locked_decision.readout: internal Locked, n=1000, one read after every checkpoint/prediction/hash is frozen
locked_decision.primary: Delta = MAE(BOSI-SSL) - MAE(BOSI-B), seed-mean, paired per molecule
SSL_PROMISING: any-unseen Delta <= 0 in seed-mean and <= +0.002 per seed
independent gain over the compute control: seed-mean MAE(SSL) - MAE(C) <= -0.003 and both per-seed < 0
locked_decision.GAIN_FROM_EXTRA_COMPUTE_ONLY: all SSL conditions except the compute-control one are met
locked_decision.NO_GAIN: the frozen two-seed conditions are not met, or only one seed exists
locked_decision.INCONCLUSIVE: seed directions disagree with a negative seed mean, or the compute control is missing

budget.gpu: res (a100-2, A100-SXM4-40GB), same execution regime as the historical BOSI v0/v1 runs
budget.counting: 1 GPU per job, wall-clock hours, failed jobs included
budget.stop_rule: if the projected spend exceeds the cap, stop; never shorten the frozen update counts

bans: official valid / official test access in any form
new molecules, external data, new label components, teacher predictions
attention, learned junction, recursive message passing, architecture search, new lookup tables
mask-ratio search, auxiliary heads, loss-weight search, extra seeds, extra epochs
checkpoint selection of the SSL state on reconstruction accuracy
reading Locked before every candidate checkpoint and prediction is frozen and hashed
post-hoc modification of the decision rule, the evaluation set or the budget
